page.overview:
Who is Sereille Bagand?

Sereille Bagand was Amyrlin Seat from to .

Due to her fierce personality, morality, sternness, and severity, Sereille became one of the strongest Amyrlins in the last millenium.

Sereille had a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai.

Sereille Bagand was born in Far Madding in 586 NE, went to the Tower in 601 NE. After thirteen years as novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year at age 39, choosing the White Ajah.
